questions.text: By Friday, I _____ finished the project.
questions.explanation: To talk about an action completed before a point in the future, use the Future Perfect (will have + V3).
questions.explanationAr: للتحدث عن فعل اكتمل قبل نقطة معينة في المستقبل، استخدم المستقبل التام (will have + V3).

questions.text: By next year, they _____ graduated from university.
questions.explanation: We use Future Perfect for actions that will be finished by a certain future time.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم المستقبل التام للأفعال التي ستنتهي بحلول وقت معين في المستقبل.

questions.text: In two months, she _____ saved enough money.
questions.explanation: With 'she', we still use 'will have' + V3 in the Future Perfect. Do not use 'will has'.
questions.explanationAr: مع 'she'، لا نزال نستخدم 'will have' + V3 في المستقبل التام. لا تستخدم 'will has'.

questions.text: I _____ finished the report by tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'will not have' (won't have) + V3.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'will not have' (أو won't have) + V3.

questions.text: She _____ studied enough for the exam.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'won't have' + V3.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'won't have' + V3.

questions.text: They _____ arrived by 9 o'clock.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'will not have' + V3.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'will not have' + V3.

questions.text: _____ you have finished your work by 6 p.m.?
questions.explanation: Questions in Future Perfect start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة في المستقبل التام تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: _____ she have studied medicine by next year?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: Will you have finished the task by Monday? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I will'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المثبتة هي 'Yes, I will'.

questions.text: Will they have arrived by evening? No, they _____.
questions.explanation: The short negative answer is 'No, they won't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المنفية هي 'No, they won't'.

questions.text: Which is a signal word often used with Future Perfect?
questions.explanation: 'by' (e.g., by tomorrow, by 2030) is a very common signal word for Future Perfect.
questions.explanationAr: 'by' (مثل by tomorrow, by 2030) هي كلمة إشارة شائعة جداً للمستقبل التام.

questions.text: _____ the time you arrive, I will have left.
questions.explanation: 'By the time' is a signal phrase for the Future Perfect.
questions.explanationAr: 'By the time' هي عبارة إشارة للمستقبل التام.

questions.text: She will have graduated _____ two years.
questions.explanation: We can say 'in two years' to mean two years from now.
questions.explanationAr: يمكننا قول 'in two years' لنقصد بعد عامين من الآن.

questions.text: We will have moved _____ next month.
questions.explanation: 'by next month' indicates the action will be finished before that time.
questions.explanationAr: 'by next month' تشير إلى أن الفعل سينتهي قبل ذلك الوقت.

questions.text: What is the structure of the Future Perfect?
questions.explanation: The structure uses 'will have' + Past Participle (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تستخدم البنية 'will have' + التصريف الثالث (V3).

questions.text: By 2030, we will have _____ a new house.
questions.explanation: We need the V3 form of 'build', which is 'built'.
questions.explanationAr: نحتاج إلى صيغة V3 من 'build'، وهي 'built'.

questions.text: He won't have _____ the book by Friday.
questions.explanation: We need the V3 form of 'read', which is spelled 'read' (but pronounced 'red').
questions.explanationAr: نحتاج إلى صيغة V3 من 'read'، والتي تُكتب 'read' (ولكن تُنطق 'red').

questions.text: Will they have _____ the letter?
questions.explanation: We need the V3 form of 'write', which is 'written'.
questions.explanationAr: نحتاج إلى صيغة V3 من 'write'، وهي 'written'.

questions.text: She will have _____ English for 5 years.
questions.explanation: We need the V3 form of 'study', which is 'studied'.
questions.explanationAr: نحتاج إلى صيغة V3 من 'study'، وهي 'studied'.

questions.text: By the end of the year, they will have _____ three countries.
questions.explanation: We need the V3 form of 'visit', which is 'visited'.
questions.explanationAr: نحتاج إلى صيغة V3 من 'visit'، وهي 'visited'.

questions.text: 'I will have finish my homework.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use the V3 form: 'I will have finished my homework.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. يجب استخدام صيغة V3: 'I will have finished my homework.'

questions.text: 'She will have went to the store.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. 'went' is V2. The V3 form is 'gone': 'She will have gone to the store.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. 'went' هو V2. صيغة V3 هي 'gone': 'She will have gone to the store.'

questions.text: 'Will you will have finished?' is a correct question.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. Do not repeat 'will'. It should be 'Will you have finished?'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. لا تكرر 'will'. يجب أن تكون 'Will you have finished?'

questions.text: 'They won't have finish in time.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use the V3 form: 'They won't have finished in time.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. يجب استخدام صيغة V3: 'They won't have finished in time.'

questions.text: 'I had finished yesterday.' is the correct way to talk about the past, instead of 'I will have finished yesterday.'
questions.explanation: It is true. 'will have' is for the future. For the past, use Past Perfect or Past Simple.
questions.explanationAr: هذا صحيح. 'will have' للمستقبل. بالنسبة للماضي، استخدم الماضي التام أو الماضي البسيط.
